summary: Smithtown descendant of Bull Smith who built a house at Hauppauge in 1790 and later moved to Commack; John's 3rd cousin 8 times removed.
bio:
Caleb Smith, the second of that name in his line, was born on 22 September 1762, a descendant of Bull Smith through Daniel Smith, Daniel 2d and the elder Caleb, which makes him John's 3rd cousin 8 times removed. In 1790 he built a house in Hauppauge, reported to have stood at Veterans Highway and Old Willets Path, where the Suffolk County Police Fourth Precinct is today. He married Elizabeth, daughter of Aaron Smith 2d, in 1795, and in 1798 he was a partner in a mill. Elizabeth was presumably a granddaughter of the Aaron Smith who was a son of Job Smith, which would make the children John's cousins through that line as well.

In 1819 Caleb moved to Commack, giving the Hauppauge house to his daughter Sarah when she married Maj. Ebenezer Smith. He died on 5 December 1831.
